topic: Tasks 01-03 are understood and counted consistently
finding: R1 (images 3 fps low): task01-03 actions are all wire/cable into tray; task02 counted 3 in 26/26 episodes, task03 3 in 18/21. Control episodes task01/00 and task02/00 gave 3-5 and 3-4 in every later run.
evidence: vlm_runs_by_episode.csv rows R1 and R5 task01/task02
recommendation: No change needed for wire/cable tasks; keep as over-count control.

topic: task06 (small LEDs) is the weak task
finding: R1 task06: 36 different action phrasings; 25/41 episodes counted 0. When the action named an LED, 8/18 were 0; generic 'component/item': 12/17 were 0; 'calibrate/scan workspace' (no task found): 4/4 were 0.
recommendation: Failure is perception of tiny objects, not misunderstanding of a cycle.

finding: R1 task04 actions split: remove hex key x5, insert hex key x3, calibrate x1; counts low (median 1).
recommendation: Define the task04 cycle (remove, insert or both) and pass it as given_task.

topic: Higher frame rate made results worse
finding: task06 total cycles: R1 3 fps low 61, R2 1 fps medium 83, R3 10 fps low 13 (34/41 zero). Zero answers come with invented explanations (calibration, idle, vise).
A 125 MB single request (task04/episode_000000, 1,531 images at 10 fps, 768 px) was rejected (HTTP 400) and made the whole batch fail; at 512 px (67 MB) it was accepted.
recommendation: Keep each request well below ~100 MB (lower fps or smaller JPEG), or use video input.

finding: No answer hit MAX_TOKENS in any run; max used 24,548 tokens (cap 65,536); all 260 answers finished with STOP. Retry at low thinking never triggered.

topic: Video input is 2-4x cheaper per frame
finding: countTokens: video ~69 tokens/frame at low and medium (identical), ~259 at high, vs images 266 (low) / 540 (medium). Full 112-episode batch estimate: video 3 fps high $2.38, 10 fps high $4.78; images 10 fps medium ~$9-11.
recommendation: Prefer video input at 3 fps high.

finding: R4: video low/medium called LEDs 'pin', 'safety pin', 'pushpin'; images and video high said LED.
recommendation: Use high media resolution for video.

finding: Identical requests at temperature 0 gave very different counts: task06/38 video v1.1 11 then 0; task06/08 12 then 0; images v1.1 10 then 18. Single-run comparisons between settings are therefore unreliable.
recommendation: Run each episode 2-3 times; retry when 0; vote / cross-check cycle times.

topic: When cycles are found, timing agrees across runs
finding: task06/38: R1 (10), R5 img_v11 r1 (10) and vid_v11 r1 (11) mark cycles at the same seconds 3-60 s; task06/32: R5 img_old (12) and vid_v11 r1 (11) align from 5-41 s; task06/08: vid_v11 r1 12 vs R2 14.
recommendation: Zero answers are misses; a non-zero answer confirmed by a second run is trustworthy.

finding: task06 median cycles: vid_old 3 -> vid_v11 8.5; img_old 3 -> img_v11 5. Object recognised as LED more often. img_v11 lost task06/32 (12 -> 0, 0). Zero answers still occur (vid_v11 3/10).
task02/00 control 3 -> 6 once; task06/22 16 cycles of 1-2 s each (one pick-and-place split).
recommendation: Add a minimum cycle length (about 1.5-2 s) and a 'do not split one pick-and-place' rule; flag cycles under 3 s (already a code flag).
